programme.title: The Gates of Hell 1941-1942
programme.desc: On June 22, 1941, Hitler invaded the Soviet Union. In the shadow of the war, Nazi regime gradually advances its "final solution to the Jewish problem".

programme.title: Genocide 1942-1944
programme.desc: Treblinka, Belzec Majdanek and Sobibor - the camps of "Operation Reinhardt," a Nazi murder campaign that took nearly two million lives within a few months in 1942/43.

programme.title: Armageddon 1943-1945
programme.desc: After the defeat of Stalingrad, the Nazis plan a kind of extended suicide on a global scale. Denunciations from the population ensure that the Gestapo can suppress almost any resistance.

programme.title: The Reckoning 1945-1948
programme.desc: After the war, winners and survivors want to hold the Germans responsible. The reckoning with National Socialism is ambivalent.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Warships secured the river borders formed by the Rhine and the Danube. The palisades, walls, trenches and forts of the Limes on land stretched across Germania, the wild "Barbaricum." The Limes was a bulwark that ran from northern Britain all the way to the Black Sea.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Was the Limes Rome’s "iron curtain", its bulwark against the barbarians? Along the Limes military camps evolved into flourishing villages, protected by an impressive boundary and the Roman legions. But how endangered were these cities? How did the Limes hold against the attacks from tribes from the north?

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War
programme.desc: Pop culture is unthinkable without them, and so is the Cold War: UFO’s, those flying saucers allegedly bringing aliens to dominate the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough in the East

programme.title: Germany in Ruins
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.desc: One of the keys of impressionism is the blending together of images. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes Turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Mustang Mayhem at the big show.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.desc: Doubling down for cars and coffee.

programme.desc: Due diligence on custom builds and their quirky builders.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The '69 Daytona Charger returns from the media blaster and Mark gives Josh a history lesson on the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel Car before removing it's drive-train and suspension.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car completely disassembled and off to the media blaster. Mark disassembles and restores the right-hand door to the 71' 440 Phantom Cuda. In addition, the headliner and vinyl top is installed in the 71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car completely disassembled and off to the media blaster. Mark disassembles and restores the right-hand door to the 71' 440 Phantom Cuda. In addition, the headliner and vinyl top is installed in the 71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The owner of the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car visits the shop and learns about assembly-line markings. Mark checks the paint on the body of the '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car and discovers a major problem.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls receives a '70 Barracuda Convertible to get a full restoration. Despite improbability, Mark straightens the fender for the '71 440 Phantom Cuda and the crew continues the restoration of the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls receives a '70 Barracuda Convertible to get a full restoration. Despite improbability, Mark straightens the fender for the '71 440 Phantom Cuda and the crew continues the restoration of the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls detail and assemble the suspension of the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The owners of the '70 Plymouth Superbird, in the queue for resurrection, visit the shop and Daren convinces the crew to throw a birthday party for Mark.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark takes some time for himself and leaves Daren in charge of the shop. The crew gets the newly painted panels installed on the '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car. And Mark discovers a chip on the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car and no one will own up to it.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The fuel and brake lines are installed in the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car. Daren quits and won't return until Mark begins the restoration of his '70 Plum Crazy Challenger. A phone-call from the Phantasm car owner forces Mark to make a promise he might not be able to keep.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The GYC crew is under the gun to get the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car finished by the end of the week. With the exhaust, ornamation, and the engine start still ahead of them, will they be able to finish the car before the director of the 'Phantasm' movie franchise arrives?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the team rush to complete the triple-black, '71 Cuda, Phantasm homage car. The director and star of Phantasm, Don Coscarelli and A. Michael Baldwin, visit Graveyard Carz to check out the homage car and hopefully, drive it around town.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The team tears down Mike Hill's '70 Superbird and finishes up final touches on Chris Driscoll's '70 AAR Cuda. Daren confronts Mark about stealing parts from his car and Mark gets a rematch on Chris Driscoll's race track.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The sewing room is transported back to the 1960s as the sewers revive vintage garments, take on time-honoured techniques and wrestle with antique equipment in an attempt to show Patrick and Esem they deserve to a place in the quarter-finals.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It's the quarter-final and the five remaining sewers sweat it out over activewear. Patrick and Esme ask them to make a man’s Lyrca cycling top, transform ski suits into children’s jackets and finally create yoga outfits in the made to measure challenge.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the semi-finals and all that stands in the way are three challenges designed by judges, Patrick Grant and Esme Young. This week they want to test the sewers’ knowledge of complex patterns and pattern-cutting. Who will flourish and who will fail so close to that place in the grand final.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Claudia Winkleman hosts the grand final of The Great British Sewing Bee. Having made it through 7 weeks of tough sewing challenges, the three finalists fight it out for the title of Britain’s Best Amateur Sewer. But first they must create 3 pieces of evening wear to impress the judges.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Jo Lycett presents as the sewers create a wiggle dress and transform three items of denim clothing and fit real live models with made to measure jumpsuits. Who’ll create clothes worthy of Garment of the Week and who will be the first to leave.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts, as the nine remaining home sewers return to the nation’s most famous sewing room for Children’s week. The garments might be mini but they are a mammoth challenge being fiddly to sew.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It's 1970s week and the sewers tackle the trickiest pattern so far, flared jeans, then transform t-shirts into punk inspired outfits in 90 minutes and create maxi dresses in the made to measure challenge.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Host Joe Lycett keeps spirits high, as the sewers jump in at the deep end, with a pattern for a lined swimsuit, but who will deserve a podium finish and will fall short of the mark, becoming the fourth sewer to leave the sewing room.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The fashion industry is the biggest polluter of our planet next to oil, so for the first time on The Great British Sewing Bee, it’s Reduce, Reuse and Recycle Week, with all the fabric in the haberdashery replaced with charity shop clothes and soft-furnishings.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: With Joe Lycett hosting, the quarter-finalists face British and Irish fabrics week. The sewers create a workers jacket Whose wool coats will be the pride of Britain and who will unravel, missing out on a coveted place in the semi-final?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The semi-finalists face three challenges from around the world. The judges ask them to make a pair of Indian Dhoti pants, transform a West African men’s tunic into a new outfit and create a garment using Japanese origami techniques.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The three finalists take on a trio of evening wear challenges. Once the final stitch is in place and the catwalk is over, Patrick Grant and Esme Young decide who will be the winner of the Great British Sewing Bee.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett kicks off the first week with 3 challenges. Battling against the clock to showcase their skill and creativity, who’ll stitch their way to Garment of the Week and who’ll unravel at this early stage, becoming the first to leave the Great British Sewing

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Things are hotting up in the sewing room as the eleven remaining sewers return for holiday week. They’ll create palazzo pants, turn towels into beach cover ups and create holiday shirts. Whose garment will bring on the sunshine and who will be sent packing as the second person to leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The ten remaining home sewers return to the sewing room for children’s week. The garments might be mini but they are a mammoth challenge. Who will climb their way to the top and win garment of the week, and who will stumble, becoming the third sewer to leave the Great British Sewing Bee?

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In their first challenge, the teams make 24 chocolate domed figurines as well as 24 desserts that are totally nuts. For the showpiece challenge, the teams create 48 chocolate bars, beautifully presented within dramatic chocolate showpieces, each featuring an Archaeology themed moving part.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the teams must produce 36 perfect prinsesstårta alongside a chocolate amenity and no recipes to follow. In the second challenge, the teams must transform a British classic, bread and butter pudding, complete with towering edible showpiece sculptures, all in 5 hours.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the teams are tasked with creating 24 completely reimagined millefeuille and 24 pavlovas served in ways never before seen. In the second challenge the teams must create a showpiece display, featuring two batches of 24 identical modern religieuse modelled on musical icons

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining teams must present 24 fruity chocolate desserts alongside 24 chocolate desserts celebrating all the delights of Autumn. For the showpiece challenge, each team must present 48 chocolate bars within a Safari themed chocolate showpiece, featuring a moving part all in just five hours

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts, as the nine remaining home sewers return to the nation’s most famous sewing room for sportswear week. It’s sportswear week, and the sewers must create rugby shirts, waterproof onesies for toddlers and tennis outfits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The remaining sewers return to the sewing room for lingerie and sleepwear week. The garments look luxurious but they are hugely challenging being made from slippery and delicate fabrics. Who will have a dream of a week and win garment of the week and who will have a nightmare, and leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The sewers are tasked with turning laundry bags into stylish, wearable garments, and then have to use old knitwear to create a made to measure jumper dress, perfectly fitted to their model. It’s a Sewing Bee first, as the sewers have never been asked to sew with knitted fabrics before.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: With Joe Lycett hosting, the six remaining home sewers head back in time to the 1980s, attempting to revive the glamorous, and sometimes ridiculous style of the decade. This is more than a stroll down memory lane, as they tackle the decade’s most tailored, fun and over the top garments.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The five remaining sewers go global, taking on garments and techniques from around the world. From the Philippines and a Filipino Terno Blouse to France and a provencal table cloth transformed into a new garment and finally to Spain and a flamenco skirt. Who will win a place in the coveted semi-final?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts the semi-final, as the four remaining sewers go to the movies, taking on garments and techniques from the silver screen. But only three of these four incredibly talented sewers can make it through to the Grand Final

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Hosted by Joe Lycett, ‘The Great British Sewing Bee’ reaches its dramatic denouement, as the three finalists compete for the title of Britain’s best amateur sewer, taking on a trio of celebration wear challenges. But who will win the coveted prize and be crowned the winner.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett welcomes a fresh batch of sewers to a brand new location on the banks of London’s River Thames. Week One sees judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young settling them in with a trio of challenges based on everyday wardrobe staples.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Summer week sees Esme and Patrick challenging the sewers to create paper bag shorts, cocktail outfits and button down sun dresses. The judges will be looking for perfectly aligned buttonholes and secure fastenings. Who will miss the mark and be the second sewer to leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: In gent’s classic week, the sewers make baker boy caps, transform old jackets into outfits for a woman, and create a casual utility jacket. Who will make something for the perfect gent and win Garment of the Week, and who will become the third sewer to leave the Great British Sewing Bee?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s international week, and the sewers make Breton tops, transform sarongs into a new garment and take inspiration from Frida Kahlo. Who will ace this creative brief and win Garment of the Week and who will have to leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The eight remaining home sewers return to the sewing room for Children’s Week. The garments might be tiny, but their fiddliness makes them a mammoth challenge to sew. Who will win Garment of the Week, and who will stumble, becoming the fifth sewer to leave the Great British Sewing Bee?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The fashion industry is the biggest polluter of our planet next to oil, so The Great British Sewing Bee returns to Reduce, Reuse and Recycle Week, with all the usual fabric in the haberdashery being replaced with charity shop clothes and soft-furnishings

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts as temperatures drop and winter hits the sewing room, with challenges themed around keeping warm. Who will cheer the judges’ spirits and win Garment of the Week, and who will be sent into the cold?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts as the five remaining sewers tackle challenges inspired by music and the movies, taking on garments and techniques from the silver screen. But only four of these five talented sewers can make it through to the semi-final.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Joe Lycett hosts the semi-final, as the four remaining sewers go back in time to the 1940s. Attempting to revive both the glamorous and thrifty styles of the decade, they tackle the decade’s most elegant and innovative garments.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Hosted by Joe Lycett, The Great British Sewing Bee reaches its dramatic denouement, as the three finalists compete for the title of Britain’s best amateur sewer, taking on a trio of challenges for special occasions.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Week One sees judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young ask them to create a capsule wardrobe across 3 challenges. The sewers dive into the competition with their first Pattern Challenge to make a wool mini skirt, with piped patch pockets. Who will make a good first impression?

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The final six must create a plated dessert for each of the judges, which celebrates herbs and spices with just the ingredients laid before them. The teams face a second challenge to create a hanging showpiece adorned with petit fours with the theme Take Flight in just five and half hours.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The five teams create 24 savoury puff pastries alongside three sharing-sized brioche feuilletée. In the second challenge they have five hours to create 30 individual desserts, within an incredible showpiece combining both sugar and chocolate work, with A Life of Amphibians and Reptiles themes

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams take on renowned pastry chef Philip Khoury's signature Dawn of a New Day dessert, a plant based masterpiece. For their second challenge, the teams have five hours to create a miniature village scene inspired by the, Land of the Giants made with bûche entremet for 40 guests.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining three teams pour all their patisserie passion into two final challenges. They step into the 1920s and create delicious sharing deserts - a chiffon pie, a decadent jelly and a baked Alaska. The final seven-hour challenge sees each team create a 1920s Banquet display to feed 80 people.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The sewers take to their marks for Sports Week as host Sara Pascoe sets three challenges for sewing garments. The sewers make a pair of high-top trainers for Sports Week. They create day wear from old netball kits and they fit a sports jacket inspired by their sporting hero to their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: the ten remaining home sewers create light and airy outfits for Summer Week, transform a hammock into a summer garment and make a two-piece co-ordinated trousered outfit. Who will impress and win Garment of the Week, and who will become the third sewer to leave the Great British Sewing Bee?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The Great British Sewing Bee does its bit for the planet with Reduce, Reuse and Recycle Week. The nine remaining home sewers to create a quilted patchwork jacket with a load of old scraps from past Sewing Bees, transform old coats into new garments and turn second hand duvets into maxi dresses.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Children’s week in the sewing room and Sara Pascoe invites the sewers to follow a pattern to make a cute sailor suit for a toddler, create an out of school garment out of old school uniform and make a fancy dress Halloween outfit. Whose costume will be a treat and who will leave with a whimper?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Music week brings a pattern for a parka once loved by the Mods, old denim gets the country music treatment, and David Bowie inspires the sewers for their Made to Measure outfits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: A lace bra and knicker set tests the sewers before they turn thermals into daywear. They must then fit a pair of luxury pyjamas to their male models. One sewers wins Garment of the Week, and another is asked to leave the Sewing Room

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The quarter finalists go back to the 1930s to take women’s sailor trousers. They also turn men’s shirts into 1930s women’s blouses and fit glamorous bias-cut evening gowns reminiscent of outfits worn by Katherine Hepburn and Bette Davis.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes the four semi-finalists into the Sewing Room to celebrate the influences of Japanese design and sewing. The Sewers follow the patterns for a kimono inspired dress, mend old denim using Japanese techniques and create an outfit using folding and pleating

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final, and the sewers take on a trio of party themed challenges. They start with the pattern for Esme’s iconic Amorphous dress, use old scraps to make a party outfit and fit red-carpet-worthy jumpsuits. The judges have the difficult task of deciding who will be crowed by Britain’s best sewer

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes 12 new sewers to the Sewing Bee. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young test the sewers with ‘Classics with a Twist’. The sewers make a top with a twist, transform the office uniform into a new look to reflect their style and create a dress that has cut out details to fit their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s not exactly a holiday for the sewers, as judges Patrick and Esme task them with creating garments based around a travel wardrobe. They’re asked to create a rucksack and a swimsuit and to transform windbreakers. Who will make a splash, and who will take a nose dive and leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The ten remaining sewers celebrate clothes from west Africa. Guest judge Nigerian fashion designer Banke Kuku joins Esme and Patrick this week. Who will impress all three judges and win Garment of the Week, and who will become the third sewer to leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Taking on the fashion industry, the second most polluting industry in the world, it’s Reduce, Reuse and Recycle week. The sewers attempt a zero waste pattern for a pair of trousers, transform several bags in to a garment and source second hand crochet blankets to create new outfits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Art week as the remaining sewers tackle three challenges inspired by the world of art. The sewers make a skirt inspired by the modernist movement, transform canvases into dresses, and draw on artists’ dreams to create fantastical outfits for a mind bending catwalk.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Kids week in the sewing room, and Sara Pascoe invites the seven remaining sewers to make a child’s dragon dressing gown. In the transformation challenge, the sewers personalise denim jackets using hand-me-downs. Finally mini models have fancy dress outfits created ready for the party.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Its week 7 and we’re going back to the 90s with cargo pants, 90s icon fancy dress and body skimming supermodel dresses. Who will make it into the quarter final, and who will take a tumble on the catwalk and leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 8, and the remaining sewers celebrate fashion icons with little black dresses, a shower curtain transformation and smoking jackets. Who will secure icon status and win Garment of the Week, and who will be a fashion fail?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the semi-final, and this week it’s three utilitarian clothing; the trench coat, housework garments and boiler suits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final of The Great British Sewing Bee, and the sewers face three challenges including a Victoriana dress, fabulous men’s outfits and a two-in-one dress. Past contestants return for a reunion, while the judges decide who will be crowned this year’s best amateur sewer.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: To kick things off the teams must rely on their patisserie instincts, knowledge and teamwork to create 36 individual tarte aux fraise and one chocolate amenity in just three and a half hours. The second, challenges the teams to a music themed Trompe L’oeil showpiece with hidden Pecan Pies

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams must turn all their patisserie experience to create 24 identical reimagined custard tarts and 24 cotton cheesecakes. In their second challenge the teams will have five hours to turn the spectacle of Carnival into showpiece structures adorned with exotic flavoured desserts.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In their first challenge, the teams must turn their hand to viennoiserie as they are tasked to make 18 cross laminated pain suisse and 24 savoury brioche doughnuts. For their showpiece challenge, the teams produce choux showpieces featuring 160 individual choux buns inspired by the theme, Circus

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The judges have a secret challenge in store for the teams, the coffee éclair, with no recipe and just three and a half hours to complete the task. In their second challenge, the teams will have five hours to create a Trompe L’oeil showpiece sculpture inspired by everyday household objects.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe welcomes the 12 sewers as we kick off the tenth series. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young set the challenges. The Pattern challenge is a denim A-line midiskirt, they’re asked to transform t-shirts and the made to measure is to create a casual day dress to fit their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s sports week in the sewing room. In the first challenge, the sewers are presented with a pattern for a half zip fleece, then transform a whole new outfit from cricket whites and protection. Finally, the sewers make an outfit for a specific sport fit for an international event.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 3 of the Sewing Bee, and the sewers face three challenges inspired by travel. They are asked to create summer blouses from tablecloths, nautical bags and French Riviera outfits. Who will make a fashion faux pas and who will turn heads with some je ne sais quoi?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe welcomes back Reduce Reuse Recycle week. First, the sewers attempt a quilted bag using scraps. programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Saipem 7000"
programme.desc: The world's second-largest crane vessel faces tense delays and closing weather during a multi-million-dollar oil rig job.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Algoma Bulk Freighter"
programme.desc: A huge cargo ship battles lake waves and ice to move grain and iron ore, navigating a seven-flight lock past Niagara Falls.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans"
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programme.desc: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Modern Stone Age Family"
programme.desc: Food Anthropologist Dr. Bill Schindler is on an international quest to discover what we should eat. Hi and his family uncover ancient culinary practices and show how they can bring simplicity and good health to the modern kitchen.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac"
programme.desc: What starts off as a seven-pound bar of solid steel will soon deliver a bullet with deadly accuracy when it becomes the barrel of a Colt C7 assault rifle, and when plastic and bulletproof fabric are molded and stitched together,they’ll make a suit of armour made for the most dangerous job in the world.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
programme.desc: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
programme.desc: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programme.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Cross Border Flying"

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Reconnaissance"
programme.desc: Reconnaissance units operate behind enemy lines, using elite training to gather vital intelligence and expose an enemy’s strengths and weaknesses.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Coalition Training"
programme.desc: Allied forces train together to build teamwork and coordination, ensuring success in combat zones like Iraq and Afghanistan.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Damage Control School"
programme.desc: NATO sailors train to fight fire and floods at sea, mastering damage control under extreme heat, cold, and pressure to save their ship.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Navy Boarding Party"
programme.desc: Modern naval boarding teams train to enforce embargoes, stop smugglers, and confront armed pirates in some of the toughest maritime operations.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Simulated Warfare"
programme.desc: Modern tech is reshaping battlefields and training. This episode explores simulators and tools that prepare soldiers for combat.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Full Spectrum Warfare"
programme.desc: Modern warfare spans land, sea, and air. This episode explores training for Full Spectrum Warfare across all environments.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Airborne Artillery"
programme.desc: Airborne artillery brings heavy firepower behind enemy lines. At Fort Bragg, we witness elite crews train with precision, strategy, and skill.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "82nd Airborne"
programme.desc: Paratroopers are elite troops, tougher and faster than foot soldiers. We join the 82nd Airborne training for high-risk, behind-enemy-lines missions.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Navy Divers"
programme.desc: Ship divers tackle dangerous missions at sea, from clearing nets and mines to rescuing lives. We explore their intense training and high-stakes work.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Trauma Care"
programme.desc: Combat Casualty Care trains soldiers to save lives on the battlefield, ensuring rapid response to injuries from IEDs and other deadly threats.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Pathfinders"
programme.desc: Pathfinders are elite paratroopers trained to go behind enemy lines, lead air insertions, gather intelligence, and execute high-risk, deadly missions.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Elite Forces"
programme.desc: Elite Forces are specially trained soldiers who carry out extreme, high-risk missions anywhere in the world, anytime they’re needed.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"
programme.desc: Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
programme.desc: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Yanukovych's Hidden Palace"
programme.desc: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"
programme.desc: Casa Poporlui is the magnum opus of Romania’s most bloodthirsty dictator, Nicolae Ceausescu, and hides secrets of an extensive underground bunker system.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "The Best Of"
programme.desc: Travel across the continent, exploring the opulent villas, luxurious palaces, remote command centers, underground tunnels, and secret bunkers of Europe’s most tyrannical dictators.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Science on Fire"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Sailing to the Stars"
programme.desc: Solar sails, the latest in space travel technology, could one day help us reach nearby stars. Follow the exciting missions laying the ground towards a new form of space exploration.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: New York, New York. A city so nice, they named it twice. The cultural and financial capital of the world. Join us as we navigate the gridlocked streets and canyons created by Manhattan’s skyscrapers and marvel at the engineering wonder of the subway.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: The celebration of culture and conservation of heritage underpin this episode on the City of Light. Home to engineering marvels, such as the Eiffel Tower and the glass pyramid entrance to the Louvre, Paris holds a special place in our imaginations.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Home to more than 37 million people, Greater Tokyo is the largest city in the world. To say it’s crowded is nothing short of an understatement. Join us as we navigate this gargantuan yet liveable city that still manages to function on a human scale.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Sydney"
programme.desc: Sydney is a city defined by its harbour: the sapphire jewel in Australia’s crown. Established as a penal colony in 1788, it remains a city of immigrants’ intent on “bending the rules”. It’s brash, it’s crass and it’s full of engineering marvels.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Naples"
programme.desc: Naples is one of Europe’s oldest and most beautifully situated cities; a matrimonio of culture and nature, staring down the ravages of time. Few urban societies remain as closely connected to their past, which is proving both a blessing and a curse.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Seattle"
programme.desc: Innovation underscores this episode, set in one of the fastest growing cities in America. Ever on the cusp of discovering the “next big thing”, Seattle is where Amazon, Microsoft, Google are forging the future.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Berlin"
programme.desc: Berlin suffered from an image problem for decades. But the city at the epicentre of World War 2 is steadily gaining notoriety for all the right reasons. It’s the leading start up city in Europe; uber-cool and decidedly cosmopolitan.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Canberra"
programme.desc: Canberra is the youngest city to feature in our series; a mere “adolescent” in our rapidly urbanizing world. It stands out for all the right reasons as it affords those who live within its low-density realm a very privileged lifestyle indeed.

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Food"

programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

programme.title: The Gunman From Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

programme.title: Hands Across the Border
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
programme.desc: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: The Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

programme.title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

programme.title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

programme.title: Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.desc: A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in the Oregon Territory.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City, drawn by a bank robbery. Hired by the town’s powerful banker Jefferson, he hunts down a gang of Mexican bandits - only to uncover shocking secrets. As Ross digs deeper, he realizes Jefferson’s grip on the town is far more dangerous than he thought.

programme.title: Long Live ... Your Death!
programme.desc: A self-proclaimed Russian prince, a Mexican bandit and a radical Irish female journalist team up during the Mexican Revolution to find fortune and notoriety.

programme.title: The Brute and the Beast
programme.desc: In 1866 Texas, prospector Tom Corbett returns to Laramie Town to find it terrorized by gangster Jason Scott and his psychotic son Junior. With his drunken brother Jeff and maid Mercedes, Tom must rally allies to overthrow the Scotts and restore peace.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As settlers encroach on Native lands, the Assiniboins go to war while Apache chief Winnetou tries to maintain peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, orchestrates attacks to provoke conflict and seize oil-rich territory. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou, and Lord Castlepool unite to expose the scheme and prevent a full-scale war.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Various factions, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.

programme.title: Execution
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Clips pursues outlaw John Coler, who cheated him out of stolen gold—only to capture the wrong man: John’s honest brother Bill, a circus performer. Now, between ruthless bandits and a chaotic circus troupe, Clips must fight through deception and danger to uncover the hidden loot.

programme.title: Heads or Tails
programme.desc: Shanda is charged with the murder of the banker, Burton and to save her from being lynched, the sheriff sends her off to Phoenix. During the trip the two deputies to whom she’s been entrusted rape and leave her in the desert, certain that she’s dead. The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: Texas, Adios
programme.desc: A Texas sheriff and his younger brother travel across the Mexican border to confront the man who killed their father.

programme.title: I Want Him Dead
programme.desc: Clayton's sister is raped and murdered. Time for lethal revenge!

programme.title: My Name is Pecos
programme.desc: Everyone wants to know who the Mexican is. He always answer slowly, "my name is Pecos". Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Behind the scenes a Bible touting Undertaker (Umberto Raho), a cowardly saloon owner, & a helpful saloon girl become part of the story. This film made Woods as internationally known as Pecos in the third world countries as Franco Nero was known for Django. A Mexican hero against a gang and a town full of gringos- what more could you ask for?

programme.title: Massacre At Grand Canyon
programme.desc: After a sheriff is murdered, his brother and fiancée fight to awaken a frightened town and stand up against a ruthless gang of hired gunmen. Justice, courage, and vengeance collide in a classic frontier showdown.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: Requiescant
programme.desc: The adopted son of a preacher comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer, who is - among other things - stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Flaming Frontier
programme.desc: Old Surehand and his loyal companion Old Wabble hunt a ruthless killer known as “The General,” who murdered Surehand’s brother. Their quest draws them into growing tensions between settlers and the Comanches. With the help of his blood brother Winnetou, Old Surehand must face both personal vengeance and the threat of war.

programme.title: The Oil Prince
programme.desc: The Oilprince, a ruthless swindler, sells a bank worthless oil wells and schemes to divert settlers away from Shelly Lake for his own gain. His plans begin to unravel when Winnetou and his blood brother Old Surehand step in to protect the settlers and expose the fraud.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: After a gang kills Apaches to steal their horses, Winnetou and his sister join forces with trapper Old Firehand. In the border town of Miramonte, they help defend the townspeople against the gang’s planned attack. As danger grows, Old Firehand also faces unexpected revelations about his former love and a long-hidden family secret.

programme.title: Crazy Westerners
programme.desc: Little Rita is a female gunslinger who travels to the Far West chasing outlaws. She takes gold from them and hides it in a cave which she plans to blow up one day and get rid of the root of all evil: money.

programme.title: Passion's Flower
programme.desc: Jeff is a charming middle-aged man who, after being released from prison, meets the seductive Linda, with whom he has a brief affair. Soon, however, Jeff discovers that Linda is actually his brother's wife and this only complicates matters further. The two, in fact, continue to see each other clandestinely, but love, in time, will turn into something macabre, at times lethal.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: To save his kidnapped wife, a warden frees a criminal, uncovering a massive political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Inglorious Bastards
programme.desc: The cult film that inspired Tarantino. Two men form an unusual friendship in an attempt to avoid death during World War II.

programme.title: The Last Chance
programme.desc: Spies, secrets, and power moves fuel a tense global chess match where lives are the stakes.

programme.title: Thieves and Robbers
programme.desc: A playboy who makes a living out of seducing women and stealing their jewellery accidentally witnesses a Mafia murder. He must work together with the man who is constantly trying to catch him, Lt. Alan Parker, in order to save his life.

programme.title: Dead Uncle
programme.desc: Cristian, who has no job and no desire to find one, has only one way out: to retrieve the urine of a jaguar in the remote Apulian countryside to carry out a very dangerous mission.

programme.desc: A chief police inspector investigates the disappearance of a 25-year-old, intellectually disabled woman, the daughter of a lonely widower. After she turns up dead, the cops race to find the killers before the grieving father does.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends.
